title: User guide 1: Set up and create a lesson
bullets: Set up classes, subjects, chapters and topics
Create a lesson with English, Hindi and Marathi versions
subtitle: User guide 1: Set up and create a lesson
narration: Welcome to user guide one. This guide shows how to set up your classes, subjects, chapters and topics, and how to create a lesson with English, Hindi and Marathi versions.

subtitle: Click Structure
narration: This is the Lessons page, and it is empty. Before creating lessons, we prepare the academic structure. Click Structure at the top of the page.

subtitle: Type the class name, click Add
narration: On the Structure page, start with a class. Type the class name, for example Class 7, in the Classes box, and click Add.

subtitle: The class is in the list
narration: The class now appears in the list. Subjects, chapters and topics are added under it.

subtitle: Choose class, type subject, click Add subject
narration: Step one, choose the class. Step two, type a subject name such as Science. Step three, click Add subject.

subtitle: Choose subject, number and title, click Add chapter
narration: Next, choose the subject, enter the chapter number and the chapter title, and click Add chapter.

subtitle: Choose chapter, type topic, click Add topic
narration: Choose the chapter, type the topic, for example Photosynthesis, and click Add topic. You do this once. Later lessons reuse the same structure.

subtitle: Lessons page: choose where the lesson belongs
narration: Now go back to Lessons. In the New lesson box, choose the class, subject, chapter and topic where the lesson belongs.

subtitle: Title, minutes, languages, then Create lesson
narration: Enter the lesson title and the target video length in minutes. Tick the languages you need: English, Hindi and Marathi. Add the learning objectives, one per line, and click Create lesson.

subtitle: One status chip per language
narration: The lesson appears in the list, with a chip for each language. Every language version starts as a draft.

subtitle: Click the lesson, then open a language
narration: Click the lesson row to open it. From here you open one language version at a time, to import and review its content. That is the next guide.

title: Remember
bullets: A lesson belongs to a class, subject, chapter and topic
Each language is its own version with its own content and review
Next: user guide 2, from content to approval
subtitle: Next: user guide 2
narration: Remember, each language is its own version, with its own content and its own review. Next, watch user guide two, from content to approval.
